summary: This generously sized four-bedroom terrace house is situated in a highly sought-after area of town, offering excellent proximity to local amenities, schools, the hospital, and the town centre.
description:
Ideal for those looking to put their own stamp on a property, this home offers a wealth of potential, though it is in need of cosmetic updating and refurbishment. With two reception rooms,bright and airy, with high ceilings that enhance the sense of space. Located on the first floor, providing ample room for family living are four bedrooms and family bathroom which is spacious and ready for updating to your preferences. Externally an enclosed rear courtyard offers a private outdoor area with convenient storage. The property would also suit an investor buyer as the property is currently tenanted. This property represents a fantastic opportunity for those looking to create their ideal home in a fantastic location. With the right vision, this could become a stylish and comfortable family home. Priced to sell, early viewings are recommended.
